title: Feature-column derivation duplicated three times
description: The expression `columns.filter(c => c.name !== target && c.name !== weight).map(c => c.name)` is written twice in this component (the Deselect-all onClick at L117-120 and the render IIFE at L131-133), and the equivalent filter `columns.filter(c => c.name !== target && c.name !== weight && !exclude.includes(c.name))` is also computed by the parent ModellingConfig (L118) to produce featureCount. The render IIFE additionally rebuilds `new Set(staleExcludes)` (already available as a memoised concept) each render. Hoisting a single `const featureCols = useMemo(() => columns.filter(...).map(c => c.name), [columns, target, weight])` and reusing it removes the duplication and keeps the include/exclude list and the count in sync from one definition.
evidence: L117-120 (Deselect all): `columns.filter(c => c.name !== target && c.name !== weight).map(c => c.name)`. L131-133 (render): same expression assigned to `featureCols`. Parent L118 computes featureCount with the same predicate plus `!exclude.includes`.
behavior_preservation: Pure extraction of an identical expression into a memo; rendered output and onUpdate payloads are unchanged.
